title: EBITDA margin is computable but breaches its plausible band on the low side
note: ebitda_margin = ebitda / revenue * 100 = 2 / 100 * 100 = 2.00%. The plausible band is [5, 60]; 2.00 is below the floor of 5, so the value is returned computable with band_breached true rather than refused -- a plausible-band breach is a flag on a real value, not a not-computable reason.
